Container.Name: nodecast-tv
Container.Overview: Modern web-based IPTV player with Live TV, EPG, VOD, user authentication, optional OIDC SSO, and Intel ARC/VAAPI/QSV hardware transcoding support.
Container.Requires: For Intel ARC hardware transcoding, expose /dev/dri and set HW_DEVICE to the ARC render node, for example /dev/dri/renderD128 or /dev/dri/renderD129.

Config.Name: WebUI Port
Config.Description: Host port for the NodeCast TV web interface.

Config.Name: Transcode Cache
Config.Description: Temporary HLS segment cache. Prefer a cache/SSD-backed path.

Config.Name: DRI Device
Config.Description: GPU device passthrough for Intel ARC/VAAPI/QSV hardware transcoding.

Config.Name: JWT Secret
Config.Description: Required for stable login sessions. Set this to a long random string before first use.

Config.Name: Intel VAAPI Driver
Config.Description: Intel media driver. Use iHD for Intel ARC and modern Intel GPUs.

Config.Name: Intel Render Device
Config.Description: Render node used for VAAPI/QSV. If Unraid shows multiple render nodes, set this to the Intel ARC node.

Config.Name: OIDC Issuer URL
Config.Description: Optional SSO issuer URL. Leave blank to keep SSO disabled.

Config.Name: OIDC Client ID
Config.Description: Optional SSO client ID. Leave blank to keep SSO disabled.

Config.Name: OIDC Client Secret
Config.Description: Optional SSO client secret. Leave blank to keep SSO disabled.

Config.Name: OIDC Callback URL
Config.Description: Optional SSO callback URL, for example https://nodecast.example.com/api/auth/oidc/callback.
